imported_methodology.name: FROZEN_PRE_ACTION_COMMIT
imported_methodology.use: Freeze the tested state, action ordering, bound chain and expected falsification conditions before evaluating or repairing the action.
imported_methodology.reason: Prevents post-hoc reinterpretation after seeing the result.

imported_methodology.name: DISCONFIRMING_CONTROL_LANE
imported_methodology.use: Preserve negative results, controls, and failed repair attempts alongside positive-looking hits.
imported_methodology.reason: Prevents selective interpretation and survivorship bias.

imported_methodology.name: MILESTONE_STOP_OR_ABANDON
imported_methodology.use: At each prime and each repair stage, stop that action and mark OPEN if exact checks do not warrant continuation.
imported_methodology.reason: Failure is data; no repair is promoted merely because continuation is convenient.

imported_methodology.name: STATISTICAL_OPPORTUNISM_GUARD
imported_methodology.use: A pattern discovered after scanning many primes is only a hypothesis until re-tested against a frozen rule on later unseen primes.
imported_methodology.reason: Separates discovery from confirmation and guards against look-elsewhere effects.

explicitly_not_imported_as_truth: future-to-past information transfer as established physics
